source_caption_text:
Jay Cinco Speaks On His Breakup With His Fiancé And The Mother Of His Kids, Lala Baptiste, On Stream 💔

“It Was A Great Experience And I’m Grateful To Have Her In My Life.. I Just Wanna Maintain A Great Relationship With Lala And My Daughter And Be There For Them” 🥹

Jay Cinco is a California rapper, YouTuber, livestreamer, and social media personality who built his following through music and online content. Raised around Watts and Compton, he began releasing music around 2020 and became known for tracks including “Ghetto Angels,” “Hood Confessions,” and “Neva Fold.” In recent years, his livestreaming and creator content have become a major part of his career. 

Lala Baptiste is an influencer, model, and digital creator who built a large audience through fashion, lifestyle, and social media content. She has more than a million Instagram followers and has worked with fashion brands while also becoming increasingly involved in livestreaming and creator content. 

Jay Cinco & Lala’s Relationship: The two began dating in 2025 and announced they were expecting their first child together later that year. Jay proposed to Lala during their livestreamed baby shower in March 2026, and they welcomed their daughter, Raine Willow-Dominique Parker, in May. 

On October 2, 2026, Jay and Lala confirmed that they had broken up and ended their engagement. They described the decision as mutual, said there was no bad blood between them, and explained that they plan to remain a family and continue co-parenting their daughter. Jay later spoke about the breakup on stream, saying he was grateful for their relationship and wanted to maintain a strong relationship with Lala and their daughter. Neither has publicly revealed a specific reason for the split.
